other_conditions: Both parents and the student must be born in Lakshadweep or have at least one parent from Lakshadweep.
The student and the Islander parent must reside in Lakshadweep.
Scholars cannot receive any other scholarships; they must surrender any awards and repay any received funds.
Retention of institutional or administrative concessions is allowed.
Eligible courses include Arts, Science, Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Law, Commerce, and related professional degrees in recognized Indian institutions.
Educational concessions on the mainland are allowed only for courses not available in Lakshadweep.
Stipends may be granted or renewed for health reasons or disability.
benefits_summary: Provides monthly scholarships and lump‑sum grants ranging from ₹600 to ₹3,000 per month depending on the course level, and up to ₹9,000 lump sum for postgraduate and research studies.
